column1: # The licence texts a program that links @kama/freetype carries, in the shape of @kama/rmlui's licenses/manifest.tsv.
#   key       an identifier for a consumer's own manifest or credits check
#   legs      which builds CONTAIN the component: `native` and `web` (FreeType is compiled into both)
#   licence   the SPDX-ish id, short enough for a credits screen
#   text      path to the full text, relative to this package's root, committed and vendored by tools/vendor-freetype.sh
#   screen    the name a credits screen shows
# ⚠️ FreeType is dual FTL / GPLv2; this package TAKES THE FTL. The FTL asks a binary's documentation to say that the
# software is based in part on the work of the FreeType Team (README.md, "What a program that ships this must carry").
# ⚠️ src/base/fthash.c is compiled into every build and carries its own MIT notice, so it is a row of its own.
